opportunities.title: Research Awards (Society of Antiquaries of London)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Early‑career researchers are welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £500–£5,000 to support research into the human past through material culture or material remains, across archaeology, art history, architectural history, material culture studies, history of collecting, and related fields.

opportunities.title: Beatrice di Cardi, Janet Arnold, Tessa and Mortimer Wheeler, and William Lambarde Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator.
opportunities.summary: Named research awards supporting projects in archaeology, art history, architectural history, material culture, and related disciplines, with no period or geographic restrictions.

opportunities.title: William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants (August round)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator.
opportunities.summary: Grants supporting the conservation of churches, awarded in two annual rounds (31 March and 31 August).
